author: Verybadsorry
body:
Hey, so over the last couple of weeks I've been seeing a lot of posts about people's suggestions on how avicus needs help.

Now this isn't a post putting down the posts like that. It's just another (and in my opinion) more effective way of telling the staff what the community wants. I know that if I was a staff member I'd be quite confused as to what to fix first because they are always getting different poses opinions on what to change so here's my idea:

All you have to do is say what you think is the most important change that needs to be made, only the most important. When I get replies I will update it, that way staff can look at this post and see what the community wants changed but all in one post and one by one they can make the changes. 

Changes!!
